careerPageUrls.title: Company career page URLs
careerPageUrls.description: Public Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, or company career URLs to inspect.

discoverySources.title: Discovery sources
discoverySources.description: Public no-key discovery feeds. Government/exam-based sources are intentionally unsupported.

excludeMiddleEast.title: Exclude Middle East records
excludeMiddleEast.description: Hard-filter companies and roles with Middle East HQ/location signals before final output.

maxJobsPerSource.title: Max jobs per source
maxJobsPerSource.description: Safety cap for each source adapter.

requestDelayMs.title: Delay between public requests
requestDelayMs.description: Conservative delay to avoid hammering public sources.

contactEmail.title: Contact email for User-Agent
contactEmail.description: Optional responsible-contact email included in the User-Agent header.

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Check robots.txt before fetching public company/career pages for enrichment. API endpoints are still fetched directly.

maxCompaniesToEnrich.title: Max companies to enrich
maxCompaniesToEnrich.description: Safety cap for website and employee-range enrichment calls per run.

employeeRangeFilter.title: Employee range filter
employeeRangeFilter.description: Filter companies by automatically discovered employee range. Unknown sizes are excluded by default when enabled.

websiteDiscovery.title: Website discovery
websiteDiscovery.description: Automatically resolve company website URLs from career pages, job descriptions, and Wikidata. No Google scraping is used.

employeeRangeDiscovery.title: Employee range discovery
employeeRangeDiscovery.description: Automatically discover employee ranges from company websites and Wikidata; ranges include source URL and confidence.
